* Body

When coordinating with payment vendors like Stripe, always clarify token expiry semantics, webhook tolerance windows, and incident escalation paths upfront. Schedule a kickoff call before the refactor begins, document decisions in shared concept notes, and obtain written confirmation of rate-limit guarantees. The auth refactor arc demonstrated that a single alignment meeting can prevent days of debugging production edge cases.
